about: Each milestone's done-when gates from the plan. A gate passes only with evidence, such as a command, a CI run, or a file. Claude flips 'passes' only after running the check.

gates.check: uv run manim -ql examples/hello.py Hello renders a video
gates.evidence: tests/test_hello.py, CI run 37479999081

gates.check: uv run pytest passes
gates.evidence: 13 tests pass on dev

gates.check: uv run pre-commit run --all-files passes
gates.evidence: 11 hooks pass on dev

gates.check: .claude/settings.json wires the format and Stop hooks
The first pull request passes CI
A 2-minute CIS 5200 episode about k-NN, in two segments, plays
gates.evidence: content/cis5200/episodes/E01-knn/render.sh renders a 102-second, two-segment episode with sound; contact sheets reviewed in four rounds

gates.check: A knowledge map and an outline exist for the economics source, written by hand
gates.evidence: examples/econ-supply-demand/ knowledge map with 13 concepts and outline; tests/test_examples.py passes

gates.check: docs/formats.md describes the formats, each with two examples
gates.evidence: docs/formats.md, with a public economics example and a private CIS 5200 example for each format

gates.check: A retro lists what was hard
gates.evidence: docs/retros/M1.md

gates.check: One source from each family ingests into a source document
gates.evidence: unfold ingest wrote six source documents in ../content/sources: a textbook PDF, a slide PDF, two web pages, a recording, and a bare topic. The slowest took 12 seconds. tests/sources has 41 tests, 3 of them slow, and all pass.

gates.check: Each ingested source produces a valid knowledge map and study notes
gates.evidence: unfold understand wrote a knowledge map and study notes for all six sources, with 8 model calls in all. Only one source needed a second try. A later run reused all six results with no model call.

gates.check: Every anchor in the knowledge maps resolves
gates.evidence: check_map and check_notes report 0 errors on all six outputs. All 154 anchor references and 193 citations resolve.

gates.check: unfold lint has written, spoken, and strict profiles, and its tests pass
gates.evidence: unfold lint has written, spoken, and strict profiles with 16 rules; the 61 tests in tests/lint pass

gates.check: The breath-group hypothesis is tested on at least 50 transcripts
gates.evidence: docs/studies/breath-groups.md: 139 of 144 transcripts studied; 92.4 percent of breath groups have 19 words or fewer, so the hypothesis holds

gates.check: The spoken profile rarely fires on 3Blue1Brown transcripts
gates.evidence: docs/studies/breath-groups.md: 1.03 spoken-profile errors per 1,000 words at the calibrated limit of 31

gates.check: The linter catches AI writing habits in a test set
gates.evidence: tests/lint/test_sets.py: all 13 AI-style paragraphs get an AI-habit finding in every profile, and the 6 clean ones get none

gates.check: The repo's docs pass the written profile in CI
gates.evidence: the lint-docs pre-commit hook passed in CI run 37571602753

gates.check: Every file format has a versioned schema
gates.evidence: src/unfold/formats defines 10 schemas, one per format and version, and schemas/ holds them as JSON Schema files. unfold check passes all 108 example and content files.

gates.check: A second build run reuses every saved result
gates.evidence: A second build of all six golden series reused all 42 outputs. It made no model call, and took 0.7 seconds.

gates.check: The first eval report exists, after error analysis
gates.evidence: docs/evals/M4-report.md: Claude read all 36 golden outputs, found 9 failure types, and wrote 7 binary checks. Their pass rates run from 33 to 92 percent.

gates.check: Golden-set segments render with no layout failures
gates.evidence: unfold render rendered all 12 golden segments with 0 layout failures. The check covers regions, the frame, text below 18 points, and overlapping labels.

gates.check: Each render produces a contact sheet
gates.evidence: Each of the 12 renders made a contact sheet. Reviewing them found five failure types, and docs/evals/M5-report.md records each fix.

gates.check: Two consecutive episodes with callbacks, and one from a second family, play correctly
gates.evidence: Three episodes play with voice and subtitles: net-present-value E01 (208.7 s) and E02 (175.2 s), whose outline calls back to two E01 segments, and velocity-of-money E01 (131.9 s), from a recording. All 6 segments pass the Whisper audio check, with word error rates from 0.4 to 4.0 percent.

gates.check: The idea-link check passes
gates.evidence: unfold eval reports ideas-link 3 of 3 for the three episodes. The series file declares term:interest, which its audience line says they know.

gates.check: On a clean machine, the quickstart produces a rendered segment
gates.evidence: On a clean macOS 26 runner, the quickstart job installed ffmpeg and ran unfold doctor, which warned only about optional parts. It rendered the bundled example: one segment, a contact sheet, and a stitched episode with subtitles, in 53 seconds in all (CI run 37739630600). An MCP client started the plugin's own server command, as Claude Code does, and its render tool rendered the same example. Cowork waits for a later release, as the spec's assumptions say.

gates.check: The MCP server, plugin, unfold doctor, review page, and gallery exist
gates.evidence: unfold doctor, unfold review, unfold gallery, an MCP server with 7 tools, and a plugin with a skill all exist. Tests cover each one in tests/test_doctor.py, test_pages.py, test_mcp_server.py, test_plugin.py, and test_quickstart.py. claude plugin validate passes for the plugin and the marketplace. On the six golden series, review wrote six pages, and the gallery kept four public series and skipped two private ones.
